narrative.text:
HEAD is clean at `17275b84`; upstream is still `ca8f6b11`, so no rebase is needed.

I’ll prevent clear failures from suppressing the next peer and separately track definitive set refusals so teardown won’t clear a status Slack never set. I’ll add the retry and teardown regressions, then rerun the full suite on all three Node versions. The PR body and comment will remain local drafts for #12.The clear-refusal regressions fail on `17275b84` and pass after the fix. Definitive set refusals now also release ownership, so teardown makes no pointless clear call—even when the refused set finishes after its peer has changed.

The new same-thread retry test detects the old unsafe `.message` read. I also reproduced all five round-2 failures on `be7c3af1` and reran the epoch-guard mutation separately. Thread-status coverage is now 30 tests; the fresh Node 22.12.0 upstream baseline passed 584/584.Final polish is committed as `85c41a5ca5f1f18e57e75e9a8fbd07b9d4e70f51`, still one commit on upstream `ca8f6b11`.

All gates passed: **614/614** on Node 22.23.3, 24.22.1 and 22.12.0, versus baseline **584/584**; thread-status tests passed **30/30 five times**. The report, replacement body for PR #12, and reviewer-comment draft are saved in this round’s evidence directory. Nothing was pushed or posted.
